fields.Name: T053 - AI Agents Browser View and Filter
fields.Description: Opens the AI application's Agents section once, then verifies the Category Tree view toggle and the Category tree-dropdown filter via checkpoints. Consolidates old T118, T119.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the AI application using the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box), then open the Agents section. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait for content rather than navigating away. Then walk these sections IN ORDER, and as you arrive at each one set "checkpointReached" to the exact checkpoint name shown: (1) agents-tree-view — in the toolbar there is a Grid / List / Tree view toggle; click the Tree (Category Tree View, folder-tree icon) option and confirm the agents re-render as a hierarchical category tree (agents grouped under expandable category branches) instead of the card grid (a valid empty tree state also counts); (2) agents-category-filter — click the Filter button/icon in the toolbar to open the filter popover, find the Category filter (a tree-style folder-tree dropdown), open it and pick a category value, then confirm the agent list responds (narrows to matches OR shows a clear no-match/empty state). Keep going until every section has been visited.

checkpoints.name: agents-tree-view
checkpoints.instruction: toggle the Agents view to the Category Tree
visualCriteria: The Grid/List/Tree view toggle is visible and clicking Tree changes the layout from cards to a hierarchical tree with expandable category branches and agents as leaf nodes, OR a clearly labelled empty tree state

checkpoints.name: agents-category-filter
checkpoints.instruction: open the filter popover and apply a Category tree-dropdown value
visualCriteria: The filter popover opens and displays filter fields including a Category tree-style dropdown widget; selecting a category value causes the agent list to update (narrow to matches) or show a clear no-results state
